_instructions: Where the execution mode's guidance goes. placement: "history" puts the mode's full guidance in set_execution_mode results in the conversation history and nothing in each step's guidance message; "both" (default) does the same plus the mode's Turn guidance (turn_guidance in execution_modes.json, or the agent's own) in each step's guidance message; "per_step" puts the full guidance in each step's guidance message and set_execution_mode results carry only the mode and revision.
